purpose: Failures captured before corrections, with the later retest recorded in evidence.json

failures.observed: Migration GhlLocationRouting1710000007000 failed because relation dealer_location_aliases did not exist.
failures.verification_sql: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN ('dealer_location_aliases','locations');
failures.root_cause: Local database had migration 0003 recorded as applied while its prerequisite table was absent.
failures.correction: Reassert dealer_location_aliases with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS before migration 0007.
failures.retest: Migrations completed; final migration RepairCustomerRepliedSourceAliases1710000020000 is applied.

failures.observed: Customer Replied for source fredericksburg returned HTTP 400: no active dealer for MyxWNKacThim798E8KC6.
failures.verification_sql: SELECT ghl_location_id,dealer_id FROM dealer_location_aliases WHERE ghl_location_id IN ('MyxWNKacThim798E8KC6','bAuMEQeH48xAtu9tAMFf');
failures.root_cause: The two Fredericksburg source aliases were missing despite the historical migration state.
failures.correction: Added an idempotent repair migration for both source aliases and registered it in AppModule and AppDataSource.
failures.retest: All configured sources accepted and queued in the final 34-case run.

failures.observed: The second inbound message '2000\nesta semana' left down_payment empty and the conversation stayed waiting_window.
failures.verification_sql: SELECT ghl_message_id,replace(body,E'\n','<NL>') AS body,qualification_snapshot FROM conversation_messages JOIN conversations ON conversations.id=conversation_messages.conversation_id WHERE ghl_conversation_id='qa-e2e-20260912-late-repair-conversation';
failures.root_cause: Webhook persistence applied whitespace flattening before transcript reconstruction, destroying standalone numeric message boundaries.
failures.correction: Preserved normalized line breaks in conversation_messages and transcript assembly.
failures.retest: Late repair became queued on the same conversation after simulated 30s; unit regression passes.

failures.observed: Laurel VA was assigned to Laurel with routing_reason 'Explicit Easterns Zone: Laurel → Laurel'.
failures.verification_sql: SELECT location_snapshot,qualification_snapshot->>'assigned_dealer_id',assigned_dealer_id,routing_reason FROM conversations JOIN leads ON leads.id=conversations.lead_id JOIN lead_dealers ON lead_dealers.lead_id=leads.id WHERE ghl_conversation_id='qa-e2e-20260912-easterns-laurel-explicit-va-conversation';
failures.root_cause: A broad qualification-memory regex treated contact name 'Easterns Laurel-Explicit-Va' as explicit dealer selection.
failures.correction: Require an explicit conversational selection phrase; contact names cannot select a dealer.
failures.retest: Laurel VA assigned Sterling in the final run; regression test passes.

failures.observed: Laurel without state fell back to source Rosedale instead of the MD-priority Laurel queue.
failures.verification_sql: SELECT location_snapshot,assigned_dealer_id,routing_reason FROM conversations JOIN leads ON leads.id=conversations.lead_id JOIN lead_dealers ON lead_dealers.lead_id=leads.id WHERE ghl_conversation_id='qa-e2e-20260912-easterns-laurel-ambiguous-conversation';
failures.root_cause: Georouting resolved MD but had no Laurel-MD branch, so it reached the source-anchor fallback.
failures.correction: Added the Laurel/MD geographic branch after explicit-state handling.
failures.retest: Ambiguous Laurel assigned Laurel; final Easterns cases all pass.

failures.observed: One unit test still expected CURRENT_TIMESTAMP after controlled-clock logic was introduced.
failures.root_cause: Test assertion lagged the intentional parameterized timestamp contract.
failures.correction: Updated the assertion to require SET next_attempt_at = $1::timestamptz and the fixed parameter.
failures.retest: Full suite with resilience enabled: 333 passed across 28 test files.

failures.observed: The first authenticated UI attempt saw 404 on /api/auth/login and later a selector timeout.
failures.root_cause: Frontend production build was created without API_URL rewrite; one temporary QA selector matched a hidden mobile duplicate.
failures.correction: Rebuilt web with API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3010, restarted Next, and made the selector target the visible table.
failures.retest: Frontend login/dashboard PASS; local lead rendered and screenshot saved.

failures.observed: The out-of-order qualification test expected raw '$4,500', 'ID-OUT-OF-ORDER', 'Cuenta verificada' and 'Este mes', but the normalized contract returned '4500', 'yes', '', and 'this month'.
failures.root_cause: The existing stress-test assertion was written for pre-normalization values; the service intentionally stores canonical qualification values and does not infer an unrecognized bank-account phrase.
failures.correction: Aligned the test expectation and message assertion with the normalized storage contract.
failures.retest: The four resilience tests pass against the local PostgreSQL container.
